# Bundled terminal assets

These browser assets are served from disk by ssh-sketchbook; no CDN or network request is needed to render the terminal.

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: [@xterm/xterm 5.5.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/xterm/v/5.5.0), MIT license in `xterm.LICENSE`.
- `addon-fit.js`: [@xterm/addon-fit 0.10.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/addon-fit/v/0.10.0), MIT license in `addon-fit.LICENSE`.

Files were extracted unmodified from the packages' `lib/`, `css/`, and `LICENSE` paths.
